title: fix(formula,lint)!: a formula whose label() names a field that declares no options is refused at author time (#28659)
body:
domain:server#2 · os-project-manager · session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XVb2k5se7JG54uScQenh4XD)_

Fixes #28659

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: updated here — `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx` now says a non-option field is refused at save; `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` already teaches `label()` as select-only and its eval `cel-predicates-formulas.json` exercises that

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：公式里写 `label(record.某字段)`，而这个字段没有声明选项（比如文本字段）时，保存对象现在会被拒绝（422 `expression-invalid`），报错点名字段并给出改法；以前会保存成功，然后每一行都读成空值。
- **为什么改**：`label()` 只对带选项的字段有意义，运行时每行都报错、静默变 null，只在服务端日志留一条 WARN。保存时已经拒绝未知字段和未注册函数，这一类漏掉了。
- **风险与回滚**：这是一次收窄（`Metadata-protocol: narrowed`），formula 与 lint 升 minor。被拒的公式本来就每行都是 null，没有能用的写法会被拒。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/formula/src/validate.ts`（`checkOptionLabelTargets`）、`packages/formula/src/stdlib.ts`（`declaresOptions` 与共用句子 `optionlessLabelSentence`）、`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`（公式检查传入 `optionFields`）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/formula exec vitest run src/validate-option-label-target.test.ts`，预期 14 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/formula`**
  - `validateExpression` gains an opt-in `ExprSchemaHint.optionFields`: the object's fields that declare options. When it is given (with `fields`), every `label(record.FIELD)` call that names a declared field outside it is refused under a new code in the closed set, `label-field-no-options` (`params: { field }`), one refusal per field. A field `fields` does not declare keeps its `unknown-field` refusal and gets no second one. Absent ⇒ the check does not run, so every other caller is unchanged.
  - The field a call names is read through `optionLabelFieldOf`, the reader the `label` macro itself uses (now exported package-internally, not from the entry), so the gate and the evaluator agree on which field a call names.
  - The refusal message is the evaluator's own fault sentence for the same call, factored out of `optionLabelOf` as `optionlessLabelSentence` (byte-identical to the WARN line), so there is no second message family.
  - Two exported readings of "declares options", side by side in `stdlib.ts`: `declaresOptions(def)` on the SERVED form (`Array.isArray(def.options)`, what the engine builds `label()`'s map from), and `declaresOptionsOnceServed(def)` on the AUTHORED form (inline `options`, or a non-empty `picklist` name, which the registry resolves onto the served field; R8's reading). Review round 1 (6559777722) found the first version read the authored body through the served-form predicate and refused a working picklist-bound `label()`.
- **`@objectstack/objectql`**: `formula-option-labels.ts` builds `label()`'s map through `declaresOptions` instead of its own spelling of the same test. No behaviour change.
- **`@objectstack/lint`**: the formula pass (`judgeFieldFormula`, the body of the `expression-invalid` rule `validateStackExpressions`) hands the validator `optionFields`: the object's declared fields that `declaresOptionsOnceServed`, plus any injected system column that does (none does today). No new rule id: the finding is `expression-invalid`, located at the formula field's `expression`.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx`: one sentence on the refusal.

The claim named `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` as the file surface. The gate's body lives in `validate-expressions.ts`, which `authoring-rules.ts` runs; `authoring-rules.ts` itself is unchanged. `packages/formula/src/` grew by the check and one code, and `packages/objectql` by the one-predicate reuse the order asked for.

## Tests

- `packages/formula/src/validate-option-label-target.test.ts` (new, 14, incl. the `declaresOptionsOnceServed` table and the authored/served picklist pair): the card's text case and compound case refused naming `first`; one refusal per field; nested calls judged; controls (select and radio with options admitted, unknown field and unregistered function unchanged, a direct read admitted, opt-in absent ⇒ nothing judged); the refusal equals the evaluator's fault message for the same call; `declaresOptions` truth table.
- `packages/formula/src/expression-refusal-codes.test.ts`: a pin for `label-field-no-options` (code, params, message), and the sweep gains a `label()` source plus `optionFields` on its typed schema, so the new arm is provoked and its params checked against the message.
- `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.object-formula-label-target.test.ts` (new, 14): `os validate`, `os build`, `os lint` and the runtime object gate (`runRuntimeAuthoringRules`) each refuse both bodies at `object 'qaformula_p4' · field 'pf' expression`; controls clean at all four, including a `select` bound to a shared `picklist` with no inline `options` (`label(record.tier)` and a compound with it); unknown-field and unregistered-function refusals unchanged.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.test.ts`: the #5017 receiver meta-test excuses the two plumbing locals (`fieldList`, `declaredNames`) whose keys are Array/Set methods; the one metadata key read, `options`, goes through `declaresOptions`.

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`, anchor `fieldList.filter(([, f]) => declaresOptionsOnceServed(f))` → `declaresOptionsOnceServed({ ...f, picklist: undefined })` (anchor 1 → 0), under the verify lock.

- lint `runtime-gate.object-formula-label-target.test.ts`: 2 failed, 12 passed. The two that fail are the picklist controls (`label(record.tier)` and `label(record.tier) + ' / ' + label(record.kind)`), refused as the first version refused them; every LIT case and every other control holds.
- Restore: blob back to `511b9f3952a6` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- No live REST probe was run for the picklist control; the runtime-gate unit test drives the same `runRuntimeAuthoringRules` the save door runs.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Which faces run the gate.** `os validate`, `os build`, `os lint`, the object save door, draft `_diagnostics`, the per-item publish and the history restore door all reach `validateStackExpressions` and agree (unit pins for the CLI commands and the runtime gate, the live table above for the door, draft and publish).
- **Two faces that do not run it**, reported, not changed here:
  - The MCP `validate_expression` tool (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`) calls `validateExpression` with `fields` and `fieldTypes` only. Both of its bridges (`runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`, `mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts`) project each field to `name/type/label/required`, so the tool cannot see options; it answers ok for `label(record.first)` where the door answers 422. Closing it means projecting options presence through both bridges.
  - Studio's live CEL lint (`ui/…/metadata-admin/celAuthoring.ts`) passes `fields` and `scope` only, as it already does for `fieldTypes`; the door's 422 still reaches Studio on save.
- **Changeset level.** The order asked for `patch`; the changeset is `minor` for formula and lint (objectql `patch`). AGENTS.md ties the level to the `Metadata-protocol` kind, and a value the door stored before is now refused, which is `narrowed`; `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` refuses `narrowed` without a `minor`. ADR-0087: `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`; the refused formula already reads null on every row, so nothing a conversion could rewrite works today.
- **Multi-value selects.** `label()` on a `multiselect` that declares options is admitted (it declares options); the evaluator still refuses a list value per row, as before. That is the evaluator's existing verdict, not widened or narrowed here.
- **Predicates.** `label()` in a validation rule or other predicate already faults (no option labels there) and is documented as formula-only; this card covers the formula field `expression`, the site the card measured.

## Verification

The record is `pm-orders/server/28659-gates-ran.txt` in the project files.
